properties.name: Quantum-vulnerable certificate on Entra app registration
properties.description:
An Entra ID (Azure AD) app registration or service principal has a certificate
credential using a classical algorithm (RSA or elliptic-curve) that is vulnerable
to Shor's algorithm. These certificates authenticate workloads and service-to-service
flows -- a compromised cert allows impersonation of the application identity.
Rotate to a PQ-hybrid certificate or shorten the validity window.
properties.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AssetKind in ("entra-app-cert", "entra-sp-credential")
| where QuantumPosture == "vulnerable"
| extend AppId = extract(@'"appId":"([^"]+)"', 1, Metadata)
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, Algorithm, KeySize, PostureReason, RiskScore, ExpiresOn, AppId
| order by RiskScore desc
